name: GEMS
summary: Christian girls' clubs for girls aged 9 to 15, run by women volunteers from CRCA churches, with Busy Bees for girls aged 6 to 8.

body.heading: What GEMS is
paragraphs: G.E.M.S. is a Christian organisation, run by volunteers, with a program made for girls aged 9 to 15. Some groups also run Busy Bees for girls aged 6 to 8.
Groups usually meet weekly or fortnightly. They are led by Christian women who are members of the Christian Reformed Churches of Australia.

body.heading: Mission and vision
paragraphs: G.E.M.S. stands for Girls Everywhere Meeting the Saviour.
Mission: "To help bring girls into a living, dynamic relationship with Jesus Christ."
Vision: "To see girls actively and enthusiastically expressing love for God and others by equipping and encouraging them to live out their faith."

body.heading: The Bible at every meeting
paragraphs: At each meeting the girls are asked, "What does the Lord require of us?" They answer together: "To act justly, to love kindness and to walk humbly with our God" (Micah 6:8).
Part of each evening is set aside to learn from God's Word, in group Bible studies or in Bible talks from the leaders.

body.heading: Other activities
list: Serving others, such as visiting nursing homes
Outings such as swimming and walks

body.heading: Three levels
paragraphs: Each level is designed to meet the spiritual, social, physical and emotional needs of girls. Girls learn to apply the Bible's teaching to their own lives and find answers to the challenges they face.

facts.label: Who it's for
facts.value: Girls aged 9 to 15 (Busy Bees for ages 6 to 8 in some groups)
